rules.ad: R14 held, with an amendment. Measured on the master, Loika's dark body does shade cool: lit b* +2 to +6 (hue 20-50), shade b* -1 to -2 (hue 320-350). The warmth is in the cream: its half-tone is warmer and more saturated than its lit side (C* 19 -> 25). So: a slightly cool core shade, a warm chroma-raised half-tone at the terminator, and on light fields (L* > 70) the shade stays warm. The build had a neutral shade tint, which made the charcoal body brown
